Overview Architecture Q&A

Understanding Modern AI Search Optimization

Generative retrieval architectures evaluate unstructured web content fundamentally differently than traditional web spiders.

How does this work?

Retrieval-augmented generation pipelines fetch page markup, extract discrete factual statements, and index passages for semantic vector search and citation grounding.

Why is structured data necessary?

Schema.org JSON-LD provides deterministic entity definitions and explicit attribute bindings, eliminating inference ambiguity for machine reading systems.

When should an audit be performed?

Engineering teams should benchmark brand web properties whenever major design refreshes, CMS migrations, or structural changes are deployed.
